description:
Two Low findings deferred on #2769: (1) Removing the per-credential concurrency groups lets runs for different pull requests use one reviewer credential at the same time. Decide whether to accept that or restore the groups. (2) The stand-in window ignores later pending or integrity-withheld oracle reviews. Decide whether a later pending oracle review voids a stand-in, and document the behaviour.

The former part 1 (the staged diff hidden from the integrity check) is done in #2798 (_project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/runner.py:114,131; tests/unit/scripts/oracle_reviewers/test_runner.py:216-243).
